summary_en: Annual dividend raised ¥60.00 → ¥72.00/share (20% increase). Year-end dividend raised ¥30.00 → ¥42.00/share. FY12/26 payout ratio forecast 50.0%, DOE 9.3%. Follows upward revision of consolidated earnings (net profit +13.6%).
title_en: Notice of Revision of Consolidated Business Forecasts and Year-End Dividend Forecast for FY12/26 (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Soliton Systems revised upward its FY12/26 (year ending 31 December 2026) consolidated earnings forecasts and announced a dividend increase on 12 August 2026. Net profit attributable to parent is forecast at ¥2,670 million, up 13.6% from the prior forecast of ¥2,350 million. The upward revision reflects stronger-than-expected sales of core authentication security products—particularly NetAttest EPS appliances and Soliton OneGate cloud services—driven by government digitization initiatives and GIGA School phase-2 deployment.

The company's dividend policy targets a payout ratio of approximately 50% or return-on-equity of approximately 8%. Accordingly, the annual dividend per share for FY12/26 is raised from ¥60.00 to ¥72.00 (a 20% increase). The mid-year dividend stands at ¥30.00 (already paid); the year-end dividend is raised from ¥30.00 to ¥42.00. The revised forecast implies a payout ratio of 50.0% and DOE of 9.3% for FY12/26.
